title: Frankenstein fast-path specificity proof
purpose: Test whether ready skeletal motion becomes story-specific through actor recipes, contact-path fitting, prop response, role-specific transforms/materials, a historical background plate and editing.

human.license_basis: underlying Quaternius UAL packs CC0; development merged binary pinned separately

specificity_method.interaction: sample Victor right-hand bone over the ready Interact clip; choose maximum reach point; fit the ready lever to that path rather than custom-keyframing the hand
specificity_method.apparatus_response: lever rotates and contact light flashes at the sampled contact time
specificity_method.creature_response: ready Hit_Chest clip begins immediately after contact while the same rig remains lying on the table
specificity_method.victor_response: ready Hit_Knockback follows, then a real retreat walk
specificity_method.environment: historical lab engraving provides high-information far background while only interaction-critical geometry stays 3D

acceptance: Victor action reads as approaching and activating a specific object, not generic gesturing
lever contact visually aligns with the ready hand path
Creature response is causally tied to contact
Victor recoils with real articulated motion
camera is not responsible for communicating the core action
scene remains understandable with audio muted
